paragraphs.zh: Die Lösung der Aufgabe sind in 3-Position des Phenylrings speziell substituierte Benzoylcyclohexandione der allgemeinen Formel (I),
paragraphs.en: The solution of the object are benzoylcyclohexanediones of the general formula (I) that are specifically substituted in the 3-position of the phenyl ring,
paragraphs.notes: GERMAN, not Chinese: the zh field carries the verbatim German as printed, per the run convention. This patent prints no [00NN] paragraph markers anywhere, so marker is null for unnumbered prose. Printed over two lines, breaking after 'substituierte'; recorded here as a single unwrapped string. The German is grammatically odd as printed ('Die Lösung ... sind', singular subject with plural verb); translated literally rather than corrected. Sentence ends in a comma because the formula drawing follows.
Formula label centred below the drawing. No German prose in it, so zh and en are the same string.

paragraphs.zh: in der die Substituenten und Symbole die folgende Bedeutung haben:
paragraphs.en: in which the substituents and symbols have the following meaning:
paragraphs.notes: Lead-in to the substituent definition list. Continues the sentence begun above the drawing.

paragraphs.zh: R1	ein gegebenenfalls substituierter Kohlenwasserstoff-Rest, der gegebenenfalls zusätzlich ein oder mehrere, gleiche oder verschiedene Heteroatome aus der Gruppe Phosphor, Sauerstoff, Schwefel, Stickstoff, Fluor, Chlor, Brom und Jod enthält;
paragraphs.en: R1	an optionally substituted hydrocarbon radical which optionally additionally contains one or more identical or different heteroatoms from the group phosphorus, oxygen, sulfur, nitrogen, fluorine, chlorine, bromine and iodine;
paragraphs.notes: The '1' of R1 is printed as a superscript; superscripts are flattened to inline digits throughout this file. The hanging indent between the label and the definition is printed as a wide gap and is recorded here as a single tab. Printed over four lines; recorded unwrapped.

paragraphs.zh: R2, R3, R4 und R5	unabhängig voneinander Wasserstoff, Hydroxy, Thio, Amino, Cyano, Nitro, Halogen oder einen gegebenenfalls substituierten Kohlenwasserstoff-Rest, der gegebenenfalls zusätzlich ein oder mehrere, gleiche oder verschiedene Heteroatome aus der Gruppe Phosphor, Sauerstoff , Schwefel, Stickstoff, Fluor, Chlor, Brom und Jod enthält;
paragraphs.en: R2, R3, R4 and R5	independently of one another hydrogen, hydroxy, thio, amino, cyano, nitro, halogen or an optionally substituted hydrocarbon radical which optionally additionally contains one or more identical or different heteroatoms from the group phosphorus, oxygen, sulfur, nitrogen, fluorine, chlorine, bromine and iodine;
paragraphs.notes: VERBATIM CAVEAT: 'Sauerstoff , Schwefel' is printed with a space BEFORE the comma. Verified at 4x zoom. Reproduced as printed and not normalised. Superscripts on R2 to R5 flattened to inline digits. Printed over five lines; recorded unwrapped.

paragraphs.zh: R6	OR12, Alkylthio, Halogenalkylthio, Alkenylthio, Halogenalkenylthio, Alkinylthio, Halogenalkinylthio, Alkylsulfinyl, Halogenalkylsulfinyl, Alkenylsulfinyl, Halogenalkenylsulfinyl, Alkinylsulfinyl, Halogenalkinylsulfinyl, Alkylsulfonyl, Halogenalkylsulfonyl, Alkenylsulfonyl, Halogenalkenylsulfonyl, Alkinylsulfonyl, Halogenalkinylsulfonyl, Cyano, Cyanato, Thiocyanato oder Halogen;
paragraphs.en: R6	OR12, alkylthio, haloalkylthio, alkenylthio, haloalkenylthio, alkynylthio, haloalkynylthio, alkylsulfinyl, haloalkylsulfinyl, alkenylsulfinyl, haloalkenylsulfinyl, alkynylsulfinyl, haloalkynylsulfinyl, alkylsulfonyl, haloalkylsulfonyl, alkenylsulfonyl, haloalkenylsulfonyl, alkynylsulfonyl, haloalkynylsulfonyl, cyano, cyanato, thiocyanato or halogen;
paragraphs.notes: 'OR12' is printed as O R with a superscript '12', i.e. the radical OR-twelve, not O-R-one followed by a two. Verified at 4x zoom: the two digits sit at the same superscript height with no gap. R12 is not defined on this page. German 'Alkinyl' is translated as 'alkynyl' throughout; 'Halogenalkyl' as 'haloalkyl'. Printed over five lines; recorded unwrapped.

structures.position_in_drawing: 1st and only, centred in the upper half of the page between the opening sentence and the label (I)
structures.core: Two rings joined by a ketone bridge. LEFT: a six-membered ring drawn with a variable-size bracket, containing two labelled ring-atom placeholders Y and Z, one exocyclic ring C=O, and one ring C=C. RIGHT: a benzene ring drawn as a hexagon with two vertical sides and three inner Kekule lines. Bridging carbon between them carries =O drawn straight up. This is the invention's generic Markush formula (I), not a specific compound.
substituents: LEFT RING, top vertex: R6, bond drawn straight up to the label
LEFT RING, upper-right vertex: the bridging carbonyl carbon C(=O)Ar, bond drawn up-right; a ring C=C is drawn between this vertex and the R6-bearing top vertex (inner parallel line)
LEFT RING, lower-right vertex: =O, double bond drawn down-right to a capital O
LEFT RING, bottom vertex: labelled Y (ring-atom placeholder, not defined on this page)
LEFT RING, lower-left vertex: labelled Z (ring-atom placeholder, not defined on this page)
LEFT RING, upper-left vertex: a bare vertex enclosed in a repeat bracket printed as '( )v', i.e. that ring unit is repeated v times; v is not defined on this page

LEFT RING, (R7)w: drawn as a single plain line running from the label (R7)w at the lower left up and to the right, CROSSING the Z-Y ring bond and ending just inside the ring. The attachment position is therefore NOT specified by the drawing: this is variable-position (floating) substituent notation with a count w. Recorded as drawn; no ring position is inferred.
BRIDGE: carbonyl carbon, =O drawn straight up to a capital O, single bonds down-left to the left ring's upper-right vertex and down-right to the benzene ipso carbon
BENZENE C1 (upper-left vertex): the bridging C(=O)
BENZENE C3 (upper-right vertex): L, which is bonded onward to R1 (drawn as -L-R1)
BENZENE Kekule double bonds drawn as inner lines on C1=C6 (left vertical side), C2=C3 and C4=C5

drawings.notes: No arrows and no reagent labels: this is a single generic structure, the general formula (I) of the invention. name and smiles are null because the structure is a Markush generic - Y, Z, v, w, L and R1 to R7 are all placeholders and no atom set is determined. Ring positions on the benzene ring were read off the drawing geometry first (hexagon with two vertical sides, bridge at the upper-left vertex, then clockwise R2, L-R1, R3, R4, R5) and only then compared with the prose, which says the phenyl ring is specially substituted in the 3-position; they agree, with the bridging carbonyl taken as C1. Structure confidence is medium rather than high for one reason only: the (R7)w bond crosses a ring bond and ends inside the ring, so its attachment position is not determined by the drawing. Every printed label in the drawing is legible with high certainty; the scan quality here is good. presented_as is 'intermediate_structure' because the enum offers no value for 'the invention's general Markush formula'; it is emphatically NOT prior art - the sentence directly above it presents it as the solution to the stated problem.

discrepancies.what: The prose names the compounds 'Benzoylcyclohexandione', which specifies a six-membered all-carbon 1,3-dione ring, but the drawn left ring is generic and is not restricted to that.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Left ring drawn with a repeat bracket '( )v' on one vertex, so the ring size is variable, and with two labelled ring-atom placeholders Y and Z, so ring members may be heteroatoms. Neither v nor Y nor Z is defined on this page.
discrepancies.text_says: 'speziell substituierte Benzoylcyclohexandione der allgemeinen Formel (I)' - benzoylcyclohexanediones, i.e. a carbocyclic six-membered ring. Not resolved here; must be checked against the definitions of Y, Z, v and w on the following pages.

discrepancies.what: The prose says 'dione' but only one ring C=O is drawn.
discrepancies.drawing_says: One exocyclic C=O on the left ring's lower-right vertex, plus a ring C=C between the R6-bearing top vertex and the vertex carrying the aroyl bridge. R6 is defined on this page as OR12, alkylthio, alkylsulfonyl and similar, so the drawn form is the enol-type tautomer with the second oxygen replaced by R6 rather than a second ring ketone.
discrepancies.text_says: 'Benzoylcyclohexandione' implies two ring ketones. Recorded, not resolved: this is very likely the standard enol/enol-ether depiction of a 2-aroyl-1,3-dione, but that reading is chemical inference and is deliberately not written into the structure record.

illegible: A small ink smudge or stray hand mark, roughly 30 x 20 px, in the white space to the upper right of the structure at approximately x 1195-1230, y 372-398 in the 1653x2339 scan. It resolves at 4x zoom into a few disconnected strokes with no readable character. It sits well clear of the drawing and of every text line and appears to be a scanning or handling artifact, not content, but it is recorded here because it cannot be read.

A single isolated dot in the left margin at approximately x 210, y 152, level with the header, and another near the bottom centre at approximately x 762, y 2098. Both are single specks with no structure; neither is a punctuation mark belonging to any printed line.
